messages.subject: Rhmr managing retries / skip
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to run a job using rhmr.  I am giving a file having file names as input. 

the job is taking each filename and processes it. Currently if a file gives error, rhipe tries it again and again until complete failure of the job.  i need to remove the errorred file and restart the job. 

I have a need to mechanism skip a filename if it throws error while processing. How do i do this ? 

Thanks,
Rajesh.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: Rhmr managing retries / skip
parts:
You have two options.

If you are using 0.72

a) rhwatch(..., debug='count')

this will capture all such errors and report them through hadoop counters. It wont kill the job.
This will trap /all/ errors thus the ones you want to ignore and the ones you dont want to ignore.

b) Or wrap the offending code in tryCatch. Suppose Foo is the offending function/expression called

tryCatch({
  code1
  foo()
}, error=function(e) {
   rhcounter("MY_ERRORS",as.character(e), 1)
})

This will stop your job from failing.

Saptarshi
